sop_markdown:
# Insert Item into Vase

Place an item into a vase, ensuring proper alignment and secure placement.

## Before you start
- Have the vase on your right ready.
- Hold the item in your right hand.
- Ensure the left side parts are sorted.

## 1. **Insert Item into Vase**
Push the item held in the right hand into the vase on your right.  
**Why:** The left side parts are already sorted, so I check them before placing items in the tray. (expert)

## 2. **Repeat Insertion**
Push the item held in the right hand into the vase on your right again.  
**Why:** Repeating the insertion ensures all items are placed correctly. (inferred)

## Check your work
- Verify the item is fully seated in the vase.  
- Confirm no other items remain to be inserted.

quiz.q: Why does the expert align the item with the vase opening during insertion?
choices: To make the item look neat
quiz.explain: Aligning the item with the vase opening allows a smooth insertion and prevents dropping.

safety: Hold the item firmly to avoid dropping it.
Align the item with the vase opening for a smooth insertion.
Use a gentle push to avoid splashing liquid.
